_meta.description: Martyr subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: sacrifice healing, melee sustain, tanky support.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la puissance de soin de 1.5% et les PV max de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases healing power by 1.5% and max HP by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente le vol de vie de 0.8% et l'ATK de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases lifesteal by 0.8% and ATK by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la reduction de degats de 1% et les degats d'epines de 0.3% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases damage reduction by 1% and thorns damage by 0.3% per level.
